name: kamod-charts
description: Preact-native SVG chart library workspace for @kamod-ch/charts.
author: Klaus Zahiragic <watzak>

scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && node scripts/test-package-exports.mjs && pnpm docs:build && pnpm size:report && git diff --exit-code -- docs/bundle-size.md
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && node scripts/test-package-exports.mjs
scripts.release:auth: npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org || (echo 'Authenticate with: npm login (or set NODE_AUTH_TOKEN)' >&2; exit 1)
